### Fertilizer prices


```{r include=FALSE}
library(kableExtra)
 options(knitr.table.format = 'markdown')
library(dplyr)

personalized_info <- read.csv(paste0(params$temp_dir, "/FR_MarkDownText.csv"))

 dds <- NULL
if (file.exists(paste0(params$temp_dir, "/datall1.csv"))) {
  da1 <-read.csv(paste0(params$temp_dir, "/datall1.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  costt <- formatC(da1$total_cost1, format="f", big.mark=",", digits=0)
  #costt <- formatC(signif(da1$total_cost1, digits=4), format="f", big.mark=",", digits=0)
  da1$unit <- gsub(" bag", "", da1$unit1)
  da1$kgs1 <- round(da1$kgs1, digits=0)
  da1title1 <-  paste(da1$fertilizer1, ": ", da1$kgs1, " kg for ", da1$field_area, da1$unit_field, " (~",  da1$bags1, " bags of " ,da1$unit, ")"," = ",
                      costt, " ", da1$currency, sep="")
  da1bag <- da1[,c("rep")]
  
  dds <- data.frame(type = as.character(da1$fertilizer1), cost=round(da1$costPerBag1, digits = 0),
                    units = as.character(da1$unit1), currency=as.character(da1$currency))
  
}else{
  da1 <- NULL
}


if (file.exists(paste0(params$temp_dir, "/datall2.csv"))){
  da2 <-read.csv(paste0(params$temp_dir, "/datall2.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  #cost2 <- formatC(signif(da2$total_cost2, digits=4), format="f", big.mark=",", digits=0)
  cost2 <- formatC(da2$total_cost2, format="f", big.mark=",", digits=0)
  da2$unit <- gsub(" bag", "", da2$unit2)
  da2$kgs2 <- round(da2$kgs2, digits=0)
  da2title1 <-  paste(da2$fertilizer2, ": ", da2$kgs2, " kg for ", da2$field_area, da2$unit_field, " (~",  da2$bags2, " bags of " ,da2$unit, ")"," = ",
                      cost2, " ", da2$currency, sep="")
  da2bag <-da2[,c("rep")]
  
  dds <- rbind(dds, data.frame(type = as.character(da2$fertilizer2), cost=round(da2$costPerBag2, digits = 0),
                               units = as.character(da2$unit2), currency=as.character(da2$currency)))
  
} else{
  da2 <- NULL
}

if (file.exists(paste0(params$temp_dir, "/datall3.csv"))){
  da3 <-read.csv(paste0(params$temp_dir, "/datall3.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  #cost3 <- formatC(signif(da3$total_cost3, digits=4), format="f", big.mark=",", digits=0)
  cost3 <- formatC(da3$total_cost3, format="f", big.mark=",", digits=0)
  da3$unit <- gsub(" bag", "", da3$unit3)
  da3$kgs3 <- round(da3$kgs3, digits=0)
  da3title1 <-  paste(da3$fertilizer3, ": ", da3$kgs3, " kg for ", da3$field_area, da3$unit_field, " (~", da3$bags3, " bags of " ,da3$unit, ")"," = ",
                      cost3, " ", da3$currency, sep="")
  da3bag <- da3[,c("rep")]
  
  dds <- rbind(dds, data.frame(type = as.character(da3$fertilizer3), cost=round(da3$costPerBag3, digits = 0),
                               units = as.character(da3$unit3), currency=as.character(da3$currency)))
  
} else{
  da3 <- NULL
}


if (file.exists(paste0(params$temp_dir, "/datall4.csv"))){
  da4 <-read.csv(paste0(params$temp_dir, "/datall4.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  #cost4 <- formatC(signif(da4$total_cost4, digits=4), format="f", big.mark=",", digits=0)
  cost4 <- formatC(da4$total_cost4, format="f", big.mark=",", digits=0)
  da4$unit <- gsub(" bag", "", da4$unit4)
  da4$kgs1 <- round(da4$kgs4, digits=0)
  da4title1 <-  paste(da4$fertilizer4, ": ", da4$kgs4, " kg for ", da4$field_area, da4$unit_field, " (~", da4$bags4, " bags of " ,da4$unit, ")"," = ",
                      cost4, " ", da4$currency, sep="")
  da4bag <- da4[,c("rep")]
  
  dds <- rbind(dds, data.frame(type = as.character(da4$fertilizer4), cost=round(da4$costPerBag4, digits = 0),
                               units = as.character(da4$unit4), currency=as.character(da4$currency)))
} else{
  da4 <- NULL
}

if (file.exists(paste0(params$temp_dir, "/datall5.csv"))){
  da5 <-read.csv(paste0(params$temp_dir, "/datall5.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  #cost5 <- formatC(signif(da5$total_cost5, digits=4), format="f", big.mark=",", digits=0)
  cost5 <- formatC(da5$total_cost5, format="f", big.mark=",", digits=0)  
  da5$kgs5 <- round(da5$kgs5, digits=0)
  da5$unit <- gsub(" bag", "", da5$unit5)
  da5title1 <-  paste(da5$fertilizer5, ": ", da5$kgs5, " kg for ", da5$field_area, da5$unit_field, " (~", da5$bags, " bags of " ,da5$unit, ")"," = ",
                      cost5, " ", da5$currency, sep="")
  da5bag <- da5[,c("rep")]
  dds <- rbind(dds, data.frame(type = as.character(da5$fertilizer5), cost=round(da5$costPerBag5, digits = 0),
                               units = as.character(da5$unit5), currency=as.character(da5$currency)))
} else{
  da5 <- NULL
}
 
priceinfo <- unique(dds)
if (!is.null(priceinfo) && nrow(priceinfo) > 0) {
#priceinfo$type <- priceinfo$fertname
#priceinfo$cost <- formatC(signif(priceinfo$cost, digits=4), format="f", big.mark=",", digits=0)
priceinfo$cost <- formatC(priceinfo$cost, format="f", big.mark=",", digits=0)
priceinfo$cost <- paste(" @", " ", priceinfo$cost, " ", priceinfo$currency, " ", "per", sep="")
priceinfo$unit <- priceinfo$unit
priceinfo$tts <- paste(priceinfo$cost, " ", priceinfo$unit, sep="")
priceinfo <-priceinfo[, c("type", "tts")]
} else { priceinfo <- data.frame(type=character(0), tts=character(0)) } 
# x = kable(priceinfo, format="html") %>%
#   column_spec(1, bold = T) %>%
#     kable_styling(full_width = F)
# gsub("<thead>.*</thead>", "", x)


costcassava <- personalized_info$costcassava
unitcassava <- if(personalized_info$cassUW == 1000){
  paste(" tonne of ", personalized_info$product, sep="") 
}else{
  paste(formatC(personalized_info$cassUW,format="f", big.mark=",", digits=0), " ", "kg of" , " ", personalized_info$product, sep="") 
    
}

maxinvest <- personalized_info$maxinvest
area <- personalized_info$field_area
unit_field <- personalized_info$unit_field
cas_unit <- personalized_info$unit_field 
currency <- personalized_info$currency
```

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.height=10, fig.width=15, warning = FALSE, results='hide'}
maxLong=data$longitude + 0.05

library(leaflet)
library(mapview)
my_map <- data %>%
  
  #leaflet(width = "10%") %>%
  #leaflet(options= leafletOptions(minZoom = 3, maxZoom = 10)) %>%
  leaflet(options= leafletOptions(minZoom = 8, maxZoom = 10)) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.NatGeoWorldMap)%>%
  #setView(lng = -95.7129, lat = 37.0902, zoom = 4) %>%
  
  # addMarkers(~longitude, ~latitude

  addScaleBar()
#addTiles()
```
